description: This file contains service functions for managing gym class bookings, including creating, canceling, and retrieving bookings for users, with database interactions via SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: create_class_booking
methods.description: Creates a booking for a class session if spots are available and not already booked.

methods.name: cancel_class_booking
methods.description: Cancels a class booking, ensuring ownership or admin override, and updates available spots.

methods.name: get_trainer_bookings_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves trainer bookings for a specific user, returning a list of booking details.

methods.name: get_class_bookings_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves class bookings for a user, including session times and class titles.
